name: Pispa
title: Descendant of Asher
summary: Pispa was a descendant of the tribe of Asher, mentioned in 1 Chronicles. He was the son of Jether (Jitran) and belonged to one of Asher's family lines. He is primarily known from the genealogies in Chronicles that document the history of Israel's tribes.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Asher's Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Pispa is listed as one of the sons of Jether in the genealogy of the tribe of Asher. This genealogy documents the important family lines within Israel's tribes.

keyEvents.title: The Tribe of Asher as Mighty Warriors
keyEvents.description: The descendants of Asher, including Pispa's lineage, were described as heads of families, brave warriors, and prominent leaders. They were counted as 26,000 men fit for battle.

keyEvents.title: Jacob's Blessing of Asher
keyEvents.description: The tribe of Asher, to which Pispa belonged, was blessed by Jacob with promises of rich food and royal delicacies.

keyEvents.title: Moses' Blessing of Asher
keyEvents.description: Moses blessed the tribe of Asher with promises of prosperity, favor among his brothers, and strength that would last all the days of life.
